verdict.rationale: Mercury Books is an accounting system, so AR aging is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents only invoice creation, sending, and tracking, plus P&L, cash flow, and balance sheet reports. Nothing in the pack shows AR aging reports or per-customer balances, and general invoice tracking is an adjacent feature rather than the capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can track accounts receivable with aging reports and per-customer balances
